name: KHM-Museumsverband
notes: Only covers the main KHM building + Neue Hofburg (Kunstkammer, Gemäldegalerie, Ephesos, Hofjagd- und Rüstkammer, etc.) via /ausstellungen and /ausstellungen/vorschau. Weltmuseum, Theatermuseum, Schatzkammer and Wagenburg are separate KHM-Museumsverband sites not reachable from this page (Schatzkammer links out to kaiserliche-schatzkammer.at) and are NOT covered here; they'd need their own scrapers. Permanent collections and exhibitions with no published end get extra.permanent=true, end=null, start defaulted to today (unknown real start).
